Name: Tool Pouch
Author: zulu333
Description:
[size=6]Tool Pouch Extended![/size]
[size=3]Thank you all for all of the love you have given this mod! While you can still enjoy this mod I have no plans to update as I have moved onto other creative projects. However! Mahsouto has been hard at work and created the Tool Pouch Extended mod! It builds on this mod and adds even more features!

[/size]Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37832]Tool Pouch Extended[/url]﻿ here!

[size=6]Description[/size]
Adds a ToolPouch to store all of your tools and free up some of that precious inventory space! With the tools in the pouch they can now be quick swapped using the selection wheel! 


[size=6]How to use[/size]
[size=3]Getting the pouch[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Upgrade any tool from Clint wait till the next morning.[/size]
[*][size=2]Have any upgraded tool in inventory in the morning.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4]Using the ToolPouch (Keyboard and Mouse)[/size]
[size=2]Method 1 (Selection Wheel):[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Select tool you want to put into the pouch using scrollwheel or (1 through =)[/size]
[*][size=2]Pressing left alt (Default key is configurable) will open the selection wheel.[/size]
[*][size=2]Click the empty slot to add that item into the pouch or click an existing item to swap with the current one.[/size]
[/list][size=2]Method 2 (Pouch Inventory):[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Left click while the ToolPouch is active or in the inventory right click the ToolPouch.[/size]
[*][size=2]Using left and right click move items in and out of the ToolPouch.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4]Using the ToolPouch (Controller)[/size]
[size=2]Method 1 (Selection Wheel):
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Select tool you want to put into the pouch using the triggers.[/size]
[*][size=2]Clicking into the left analog stick (L3) will open the selection wheel.[/size]
[*][size=2]Using the right analog stick (Can be configured for left) Point in the direction of the tool you want. A hover state will show, let go to switch.[/size]
[/list]Method 2 (Pouch Inventory):
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Cry... I have failed at making this inventory supported... Need Halp...[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=6]Install[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=6]
Config Options[/size]
Config should support [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] Let me know if you run into issues!
﻿BagCapacity (Default: 9)
        UseBackdrop (Default: true)
        AnimationMilliseconds (Default: 150)
        LeftStickSelection (Default: false if set to true RightStickSelection) 
        HoverSelects (Default: false)
        ToggleKey (Default: SButton.LeftAlt)
﻿ControllerToggleKey (Default: SButton.LeftStick)
﻿DisableOpeningPouchOutsideOfInventory (Default: false) If playing Splitscreen and potentially Multiplayer its recommended to turn this to true. There is a current bug in Splitscreen that sometimes opens the pouch for everyone.

[list]
[/list][size=5]Potential Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Pouch upgrades?
[*]Config for locking down what can go in the pouch
[/list][size=5]
Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]No Controller support for the ToolPouch menu.
[*]Multiplayer menus pulling up for everyone when DisableOpeningPouchOutsideOfInventory is false.
[*]Please let me know if you find any!
[/list]
